B.idol in Seoul 2025 Summer

B.Idol is a program that provides an opportunity to become a K-pop idol and introduce Korean culture, through learning the Korean language, dance, vocals, modeling, and more than 10 K-pop company trainees audition and tour in Korea for 12 days in Seoul, South Korea.

12 Days

Tags.

All inclusive camp, K-Pop companies audition, Summer camp

APPLY NOW
BOOK AN ONLINE CONSULTING

Location : Hi Seoul Youth Hostel (Seoul)
Date : 24th July, 2025 - 04th August, 2025
Price: Full price 2,490 USD
Before 15 February 2,241 USD
Before 15 March 2,365.5 USD
Extra 5% discount for ex-camp participants.

ACCOMMODATION

Located in Yeongdeungpo in the heart of Seoul, HI Seoul Youth Hostel is housed in a state-of-the-art building that’s more like a hotel than a hostel.
It’s near to many major tourist attractions and is easily accessible via public transport.
The hostel features lovely modern dorm rooms with tables, chairs, and TV, there’s free Wi-Fi throughout the whole building, a movie room, bakery and cafe, a large open space lounge, and a selection of fully-equipped conference rooms. 

CLASSES

Korean Language (Topik 2)

Korean language classes taught by a renowned Korean instructor for Topik 2 level.

​

Dance Classes

The participants will visit two of the most iconic dance studios in South Korea and will have special dance classes.

Just Jerk Academy, 1Million Dance Studio, and a special class of K-Pop dance fundamentals.

Vocal Classes 

Jiae Kim @keepgoing_z.ae

Trainer of : Seohyun(SNSD), Red Velvet, Lovelyz(K),Mamamoo(Munbyul), AOA(Yoona), IZONE, Weki Meki,Golden Child, Rocket Punch, Cherry Bullet, Drippin, Hello Venus, Mathilda, UP10TION etc...

FAQ
Regulations
Audition
Payment

   Event Regulation

​

  • Please keep the time of the timetable.

  • Excess noise, drinking, and gambling are prohibited inside the camp. If any staff has found that the participants are doing the wrong things, we may ask them to leave the facility.

  • Smoking is only allowed in designated places. But we are recommending not to bring it to camp for safety

  • Cooking is prohibited in the facility.

  • There will be a staff all the time. If the participants have an allergy or special dietary, let the staff be informed beginning of the camp for further assistance.

  • Parents may visit the venue if they want.

​​

  Refund policy

​​

  • The cancellation fee is 10% of the full price. 

  • The cancellation fee before 60 days of the program starting date is 30% of the full price.

  • The cancellation fee before 30 days of the program starting date is 40% of the full price.

  • The cancellation fee before 15 days of the program starting date is 50% of the full price.

  • There's no refund after day 10th of July 2025.

   Payment method

​​​

  • After the registration, we'll send you a invoice with the payment method by email.

  • There are 2 options for payment, by Bank account transfer or credit card(There's an extra fee).

  • After the payment, we'll send you a confirmation email.

  • After the payment, you'll receive a participant manual with detailed information about the program.

Q. How can pay the participation fee?

A. First, you need to register for free. After the registration, we'll send you an email with the payment instruction

Q. Can minors participate?

A. Yes, they can. 

Q. Can I pay in installments?

A. Yes, you can. However, you need to make all the payments before the start of the program. Please contact us for the installments

Q. How can I book the class?

A. We'll instruct you after the payment.

Q. Is the tour fee included?

A. Yes, all entrance fees and guide are included

Q. Airport pickup is included?

A. Yes, it's included but we provide the airport pickup only on day 24 July and 4 August.

Q. Can foreigners participate?

A. Yes, we don't have any ethnical limitations.

Q. Does it include a flight ticket?

A. No, it doesn't

Q. What's the difference between standard and premium rooms?

A. It's a condition of each room.

Q. Can I arrive one day earlier or leave a day after the camp?

A. Yes, with an additional 40 USD per night you can arrive on the day 23 July or leave on day 5 August.

  • The K-Pop trainee audition will be hosted on the second day of camp and will join 2-3 companies offline and more than 15 companies online. 

  • All the participants should prepare 1 minute of the song(Acapella) for the vocal test and 1 minute of dance.

  • All the participants should bring a song on their phones for the dance audition.

  • If you're selected for the second round of auditions, the recruiter will call you again for a detailed audition.

  • If you're selected in the audition by a recruiter, you'll become their trainee.
